title: Material Buildroot reviewed screenshot gallery
imageBytePolicy: Every PNG is a byte-for-byte copy of its reviewed source capture. No image was edited, resized, recompressed, or retouched.
captureDatePolicy: A capture timestamp is shown only when its source manifest records one. Website receipt check times are listed separately and do not stand in for screenshot capture times.

groups.label: BIOS ISO boot profile
groups.note: Four successful guest-console captures bind to ISO SHA-256 1d75d40b94e3c441aaaead9109f8074f62334931e1d84a576f3d7a36ec566dba. Acceptance is limited to QEMU 10.0.13, PC BIOS/GRUB2, qemu64, Cirrus VGA, RTL8139, 512 MiB, one CPU, and guest SLIRP. It does not establish physical hardware, UEFI, persistence, Internet, or general compatibility.

groups.label: Alternate QEMU profile faults
groups.note: Two early guest-kernel faults from separate VirtIO/qemu64 and max-CPU trials against ISO SHA-256 1d75d40b94e3c441aaaead9109f8074f62334931e1d84a576f3d7a36ec566dba. These are failed-profile captures, not successful boots; the sanitized acceptance does not record every remaining device parameter.
groups.labelZh: 其他 QEMU 設定故障
